headline: Oil prices start rising due to new Iranian demands
summary: Oil prices rose on Sunday, August 9, after Iran said it was not entering negotiations with the US and presented a list of demands. The article gives no further details.
why: Brent crude is the main global oil benchmark, and supply risks linked to Iran, a major oil producer, feed directly into global energy prices.
why_moved: Oil prices rose after Iran said it was not entering negotiations with the US and presented a list of demands, raising the risk of supply disruption.
